changelog: Initial release: drive the user's own logged-in system browser over CDP with Playwright (reuse session, no 2FA re-login). Per-step scripts, shadow-DOM/overlay handling, identity-wall handoff, one-time-secret capture, remote VPS+local browser SSH tunnel, cleanup.
